verdict.rationale: The dependency scanning docs mention merge requests that bump a dependency, and say GitLab Duo can analyze a failed pipeline on such an MR and provide fixes. GitLab's homepage also claims agents turn issues into merge requests and remediate vulnerabilities. Neither source explicitly documents GitLab generating upgrade paths or opening fix MRs for vulnerable dependencies. missing for 10: explicit documentation of recommended upgrade versions or paths for vulnerable dependencies, auto-generated dependency-bump merge requests, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can get concrete upgrade paths or automated fix pull requests that remediate vulnerable dependencies

citations.quote: When a merge request that bumps a dependency has a failed pipeline, GitLab Duo can analyze the failure and provide fixes to resolve it.
Teams orchestrate, agents execute, turning issues into merge requests, remediating vulnerabilities, and reviewing code, all inside the guardrails you set.
